text:
Maya (sales): HelixCare wants to onboard their Helix-Med-30B-FT variant for a 14-day POC. They asked what we need to add it to the catalog and whether we can support BYOK + long-context. Thoughts?
Diego (SE): echo. quick checks: artifact type (full checkpoint vs sharded), tokenizer differences, and whether they used QAT or post-training PTQ. Also need expected request sizes.
Asha (HelixCare): artifact is sharded safetensors (4 shards). trained in FP16 then PTQ to 8-bit, no QAT. Tokenizer is sentencepiece with 4 extra tokens for device IDs. Typical traffic: 60 rps steady, bursts to 220 rps; sequences usually 256-2k, occasional 16k long reports. Will need VPC deploy and strict logging redaction.
Rina (solutions): plan: 1) upload artifacts + meta -> run compatibility adapter job 2) tokenization mapping test (special tokens must be preserved) 3) 2k and 16k generate runs to profile KV and memory 4) quantify cost delta for hosted vs dedicated when long-context is common 5) draft network + KMS requirements for BYOK.
Diego (SE): adding: verify sharded load path (we've seen OOM if shard load sequence isn't optimized), and test LoRA/adapter fusion if they add adapters. Compatibility run command (staging):
```
curl -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/compat/check \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_STAGING" \
  -F "artifact=@helix_med_30b_sharded.tar.gz" \
  -F "meta=@meta.json" \
  -F "samples=@samples.zip"
```
Maya (sales): I'll send the upload link and ask for 8-10 samples including tokenization edge cases and a heavy 16k doc. Asha can you also provide any expected tokenized samples?
Asha (HelixCare): uploading in ~2h. will include raw->tokens, PHI-marked and non-PHI examples.
Owen (security): intake list: vendor questionnaire, data flow diagram, KMS ARN for BYOK, expected retention periods, and whether logs are permitted off-VPC. For PHI we require VPC-only and no external telemetry. Asha: confirm you'll sign the PHI addendum.
Asha (HelixCare): yes to PHI addendum and BYOK. prefer HSM-backed keys.
InfraBot: scheduled compat-run job #cr-3421 on 2025-08-07T03:00:00Z (staging). Estimated duration: 55m.
Diego (SE): perf note: 30B int8 on A100-ish dedicated pool we can aim for 95p token latency ~90-140ms for <=512 tokens. For 2k sequences p95 will rise; 16k full-context will be much higher and dominated by KV transfer costs. We'll provide measured numbers after the run.
Rina (solutions): pricing: I'll produce an initial Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (VPC) cost comparison. Preliminary: if >5% of calls hit 16k, Dedicated/Private with larger memory nodes likely cheaper.
Maya (sales): can we propose a fallback policy? e.g., non-PHI -> route to a smaller distilled variant during capacity pressure; PHI -> always Private. Asha?
Asha (HelixCare): acceptable for non-PHI. PHI requests must remain on Private and never be routed out.
Owen (security): we'll author a routing rule: metadata.phi=true -> route_policy=private-only; also disable external telemetry for those requests. Looping legal for addendum.
Diego (SE): tests to run once samples arrive: tokenizer diff, sharded load stress, 2k & 16k generate, memory/KV profiling, and a latency with batching profile at 60/220 rps. ETA for results: 24-48h after samples.
Maya (sales): owners: artifact & samples (Asha), compat tests (Diego), pricing (Rina), security intake (Owen). I'll send calendar invite for a sync after we have perf numbers.
Asha (HelixCare): samples uploaded. thanks team! :pray:
